item.title: Consulting & Collaboration
item.description:
I have been working on AI code review and agent engineering for a long time, and I maintain my own production-grade system (privately deployed — happy to demo it on request). If you have concrete questions in these areas, we can talk:

Area Details
Review agent design session-based and incremental review, multi-persona orchestration, verdict contracts, false-positive control
LLM cost & cache tuning prefix cache hit rate, request shape, model routing and cost observability (see this site’s measured write-ups: DeepSeek prefix cache, AI code review practice)
Gitea / CI automation self-hosted forge, webhook integration, self-hosted runner pitfalls

Formats: per-session consulting, solution design, or small-scale custom work. No long-term on-site engagement.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
This privacy policy explains how svtter.cn (“we”, “this site”) collects, uses, and protects data when you visit. We comply with applicable data protection regulations.

Data We Collect

Automatically Collected Information

When you visit this site, the server and third-party services may automatically record the following non-personal information:

  • Access logs (IP address, access time, requested URL, browser User-Agent, referring page)
  • Approximate geographic location (country/region level, inferred from IP)
  • Aggregated statistics such as device and browser type, screen resolution, etc.

This information is used only for operations, security auditing, and traffic analytics. It is not used to identify you personally.

item.title: LLMs
item.description:
2026-09-18

  • ZCode (security incident) retired: it silently uploads users’ full Git history — workspace snapshots (including the complete .git history) are encrypted and uploaded to cloud OSS with no decryption key held locally, and the snapshot toggle in settings is not on the collection path, so it cannot actually be disabled. See ferstar’s forensic writeup and the incident analysis.

2026-08-03

Use Model / Tool
Coding Kimi K3 + GLM-5.2
Code Review Xiaomi MiMo token plan
Agent Client oh-my-pi / ZCode (security incident) / Kimi Code / Hermes (DeepSeek-V4-Flash)
Talk Kimi-K2.6

MiMo is no longer used as a coding agent. The MiMo token plan is reserved for code review only — it’s the cheapest plan, and review workloads hit prefix cache heavily, so the cost bottoms out.
